options.title: Locate the Main Console for the 3rd Floor Conference room

steps.instruction: You can find the main console atop the center table. Looks something like this:
Let's start from scratch, try to reset the console to start from the home screen
steps.alt: Video showing how to exit out of device mode and return to HOME
Shows the button for Device Mode on the Main Console

steps.instruction: If done succefully, your Main Console panel should look like this:
steps.alt: What the Main Console looks like after activating Device Mode

steps.instruction: Now, let's turn our attention to the Main TV
steps.alt: Picture showing the main TV off

steps.instruction: Is the TV on? If not, try to locate the remote to turn it on! The remote should something like this:
steps.alt: Picture of the Samsung TV remote for TV

steps.instruction: At your own pace, turn the TV on
steps.alt: Pic showing the Main TV On

steps.instruction: Now, let's locate our keyboard and mouse. They normally exist on the same shared table in the middle of the room:
steps.alt: Pic of the Keyboard and Mouse for the 3rd Fl Conference room

steps.instruction: Make sure both devices are on!

images.alt: Pic showing the switch for Keyboard
Pic showing the switch for Mouse

steps.instruction: Try moving the mouse around or click on keys on the keyboard. Now click on 'Other User' on the bottom left and sign into your profile!
steps.alt: Pic displaying the 'Other Users' log in screen on the Main TV
